ledger: Gravity acting on balls dropping into the bowl: consistent.
Physical force of child's hand manipulating the balls: consistent initially, highly inconsistent during the swirling action.

findings.description: The child moves his hand in a slow circular motion to swirl the balls, but the balls instantly accelerate to an impossibly high speed, blurring into a continuous ring of color. The slow physical input from the hand cannot plausibly cause this extreme kinetic energy.
